CONNECT.TITLE: Connect {{name}}

CARD.CONFIRM_REMOVE_ARIA: Confirm that you are removing the asset
CARD.REMOVE_BODY: We will stop assessing it and it will no longer appear in your list. What we already measured is kept as history. If you want it back, you will have to register it again.

EDIT.TITLE: Edit this asset
EDIT.NAME: Name
EDIT.ACCOUNT_GCP_HELP: You can see it in the project picker of the Google Cloud console. It is the ID, not the name or the number. If you change it, run the setup command again.
EDIT.ROLE_HELP: It's the “RoleArn” value in the Outputs tab of the stack in AWS.
EDIT.KEYS_HELP: For security we don't show the saved keys. Leave them empty to keep them, or paste the two new ones to replace them.
EDIT.CHANGES_CONNECTION: You changed what is assessed, so after saving you will have to check the connection again. What we already measured is kept.
EDIT.EVALUATE_SAVE_FIRST: Save your changes first so we evaluate with the new details.
EDIT.SAVE_ERROR: We couldn't save the changes. Try again.

PANEL.TITLE: Give read-only access to your AWS account
PANEL.INTRO: You create a role that can only read your account's configuration. You don't share passwords or keys.
PANEL.PASTE_VALUES: When AWS asks for the parameters, paste these two values:
PANEL.MISSING_PRINCIPAL: Monkey cannot generate the role details yet. Contact Monkey before continuing.
PANEL.ROLE_HELP: It's the “RoleArn” value in the Outputs tab of the stack in AWS.
PANEL.CHECKING: Checking access to your AWS account…
PANEL.DOWNLOAD_ERROR: We couldn't download the template. Try again.

PANEL.SAVE_ROLE_ERROR: We couldn't save the role. Try again.

FORM.NAME_HINT: Give it a name so you can recognize it later.

FORM.ACCOUNT_HINT: Enter the 12 digits of the account.
FORM.REGIONS_LABEL: In which regions do you have resources?
FORM.REGIONS_HELP: We will only look at the regions you choose. You can select several.
FORM.KEYS_NOTE: Use an IAM user that only has the SecurityAudit and ViewOnlyAccess policies. The key is stored encrypted and is not shown again.
FORM.IMPORTANCE: How important is it for your service?
FORM.ALSO_SUPPORTS: Does it also support other services?
FORM.ALSO_SUPPORTS_HELP: This way you don't register it twice. It's optional.
FORM.CHECK_MARKED: Check the marked fields and try again.
FORM.METHOD_NOT_APPLICABLE: That connection type isn't available for this platform. Choose another one.

SERVER_FORM.TITLE: Your server's details
SERVER_FORM.NOTE: We only ask for the server name and system. Next we give you a command with its key, shown only once.
SERVER_FORM.VERSION_LABEL: Which version of {{name}} does it run?
SERVER_FORM.VERSION_HELP: With the version we build the right command for your server and know what to check on it.
SERVER_FORM.VERSIONS_ERROR: We couldn't load the available versions. Check your connection and try again.
SERVER_FORM.REGISTER_ERROR: We couldn't register the server. Try again.

AGENT.TITLE: Install the Monkey probe on this server
AGENT.INTRO: The probe is a program that reads your server's configuration ({{version}}) and sends it to Monkey to be assessed. It only reads: it changes nothing.
AGENT.BEFORE_ADMIN_LINUX: Sign in to the server as an administrator: as root, or as a user who can use sudo.
AGENT.BEFORE_ADMIN_WINDOWS: Sign in to the server as an administrator and open PowerShell with “Run as administrator”.
AGENT.BEFORE_OUTBOUND: The server must be able to connect to {{host}} on port {{port}} (outbound connection). You don't need to open any inbound port.
AGENT.START_HELP: When you're ready, we prepare this server's key. It takes a few seconds.
AGENT.PREPARING: We're preparing this server's key. A few seconds…
AGENT.READY_WARNING: All set. When you show the command you'll see this server's key, and it's shown only once: have the server where you'll paste it at hand.
AGENT.ONCE_WARNING: Copy it now. It contains this server's key and we won't show it again. If you lose it, generate a new one.
AGENT.OR_FILE: Or download the file and run it in {{shell}}:
AGENT.WAITING: Waiting for the server to connect. It can take a couple of minutes after you run the command.
AGENT.ALREADY_SHOWN: The command was already shown and can't be seen again.
AGENT.CONNECTED: The server is connected. Monkey can now receive its information.
AGENT.REGENERATE: Didn't get to copy it? Generate a new command
AGENT.REGENERATE_CONFIRM: A new key is created and the previous one stops working. If you already ran the previous command on the server, you'll need to run the new one.
AGENT.NOT_READY: The command was already shown or has expired. Generate a new one to continue.
AGENT.UNAVAILABLE: Server connections are not available in your account yet. Contact Monkey to enable them.
AGENT.IN_PROGRESS: We're already preparing this server's key. Wait a few seconds.
AGENT.WAITING_AUTO: We check every few minutes; the status changes by itself when it connects.
AGENT.CHECK_IN_PROGRESS: We're already checking this server. You'll see the result in a moment.
AGENT.CHECK_FAILED: We couldn't check the server. Try again in a few minutes.
AGENT.CHECK_SLOW: The check is still running. Look again in a few minutes: if the server connects, this status changes by itself.
AGENT.EXPIRED: We didn't see the server connect in the last 24 hours. Check that the command ran without errors and that the server can reach {{host}}:{{port}}. If you're not sure, generate a new command.
AGENT.DISCONNECTED: The server stopped reporting to Monkey. Check that it is on and that it can reach {{host}}:{{port}}. When it's back, it connects by itself.
AGENT.ERROR: We couldn't complete this step. Try again.

REVIEW.MAIL_INCLUDED: The last assessment included the email review.
REVIEW.TITLE: Review of your account

CHOOSE.TITLE: How do you want to connect GCP?
CHOOSE.SUBTITLE: Choose what you connect and how you grant access. Options that are not ready yet are shown locked.
CHOOSE.SCOPE_TITLE: What do you want to connect?
CHOOSE.READ_ONLY: Monkey only reads the configuration of your project: it never creates, changes or deletes anything. You share no keys or passwords.

PROJECT.TITLE: Your project details
PROJECT.SUBTITLE: Tell us which Google Cloud project you are connecting and what to call this connection.
PROJECT.ID_HELP: You can see it in the project picker of the Google Cloud console. It is the ID, not the name or the number.
PROJECT.ID_INVALID: The ID is 6 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, starting with a letter.

ACCESS.TITLE: Give Monkey read-only access
ACCESS.SUBTITLE: Run this command in Cloud Shell, in the project {{project}}.
ACCESS.NO_COMMAND: Monkey cannot generate the command for your project yet. Contact Monkey before continuing.
ACCESS.NO_KEYS: The command includes no keys or passwords, and you can revoke the access any time from your project.

CHECK.TITLE: Check the connection
CHECK.SUBTITLE: When it finishes, the command prints your project number. Paste it here and Monkey will check the access.
CHECK.NUMBER_INVALID: Paste the project number the command printed: 6 to 19 digits.
CHECK.ACCESS_ERROR: We could not reach your project. Check that the command finished without errors and check again.

RESULT.TITLE: Your project is connected
RESULT.SUBTITLE: Monkey can now read the configuration of your Google Cloud project.

LEAVE.TITLE: Leave the connection?
LEAVE.DISCARD: If you leave now, what you have so far on this connection will be lost.
LEAVE.SAVED: Your progress is saved. You can continue this connection from the service connections.

COMMON.NAME_HELP: A name that helps you recognize it, for example “Production”.

RESULT.NAME: Connection
RESULT.NEXT: Next step: in the connection you choose which assets belong to the service and turn on the automatic assessment.

CHOOSE.TITLE: How do you want to connect AWS?
CHOOSE.SUBTITLE: Choose how you grant read-only access to your account.
CHOOSE.READ_ONLY: Monkey only reads the configuration of your account: it never creates, changes or deletes anything.

ACCOUNT.TITLE: Your account details
ACCOUNT.SUBTITLE: Tell us which AWS account you connect, in which regions you have resources and what you want to call this connection.

ACCESS.ROLE_SUBTITLE: Create a role in your AWS account that can only read.
ACCESS.NO_KEYS: You share no passwords or keys, and you can delete the role whenever you want.
ACCESS.KEYS_SUBTITLE: Use the key of a user that can only read. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.

CHECK.TITLE: Check the connection
CHECK.ROLE_SUBTITLE: Paste the role ARN that AWS gave you when creating the stack and Monkey will check the access.
CHECK.KEYS_SUBTITLE: Monkey will check the access with the key you pasted.

RESULT.TITLE: Your account is connected
RESULT.SUBTITLE: Monkey can now read the configuration of your AWS account.

WIZARD.OPTIONS_ERROR: We couldn't load the options. Check your connection and try again.

DATA.TITLE: Connect Microsoft 365
DATA.SUBTITLE: Give it a name you will recognize. There are no codes, passwords or IDs to copy.
DATA.PROMISE_READ: Monkey reviews the user, mail and security settings of your organization.
DATA.PROMISE_NO_CHANGES: Access is read-only: Monkey does not change or delete anything.
DATA.PROMISE_NO_SECRETS: We never see your password: you sign in on the Microsoft page.

ACCESS.TITLE: Authorize access
ACCESS.SUBTITLE: You will go to the Microsoft page. When you finish, you will come back here automatically.
ACCESS.WHO: a Global Administrator (or Privileged Role Administrator) of your organization. Other accounts cannot continue.
ACCESS.NAMES: a sign-in screen and then the list of permissions. A mail permission is named “Manage Exchange As Application”; on its own it cannot see or change anything: that depends on the read-only role you may assign afterwards.
ACCESS.START_ERROR: We could not open the Microsoft page. Try again.
ACCESS.UNAVAILABLE: The Microsoft 365 connection is not available yet. Your connection was saved; try again later.

CHECK.TITLE: Checking the connection
CHECK.SUBTITLE: Keep this screen open. It usually takes less than a minute.
CHECK.WAITING: Microsoft is applying the permissions. We will check again in a few seconds (attempt {{attempt}} of {{total}}).

RESULT.TITLE: Microsoft 365 is connected
RESULT.SUBTITLE: Monkey can now read the settings of your organization.

MAIL.TITLE: Recommended: include the mail review
MAIL.WHY: Microsoft does not grant this permission when you authorize. Without it, mail checks stay “not measured” (never as met).
MAIL.STEP_1: Open Microsoft Entra roles with your administrator and search for “Global Reader”.
MAIL.STEP_2: Open the role and choose “Add assignments”.
MAIL.STEP_3: Search for the “Monkey” application, select it and save. It is a read-only role.
MAIL.LATER: You can do it later: it applies on the next evaluation.

RETURN.TITLE: We could not finish the authorization
RETURN.CANCELLED: The authorization was not completed on Microsoft. Whenever you want, select “Sign in with Microsoft” again.
RETURN.EXPIRED: The authorization expired or was opened in another session. Select “Sign in with Microsoft” again.
RETURN.NOT_ADMIN: That account cannot authorize. Sign in with a Global Administrator of your organization.
RETURN.PERSONAL_ACCOUNT: You signed in with a personal account. Use the work account of an administrator of your organization.
RETURN.IDENTITY_REJECTED: We could not safely verify the account or the organization. Try again using the same organization in both steps.
RETURN.UNAVAILABLE: We could not reach Microsoft right now. Try again in a few minutes.
